sql-formatter.html.desc_meta: Format and beautify your SQL queries instantly. Support for MySQL, PostgreSQL, and SQL Server. Free online SQL formatter — 100% private.
sql-formatter.html.sub: Transform messy, single-line SQL queries into clean, readable code with proper indentation.
sql-formatter.html.intro_p: Reading long, unformatted SQL queries is a challenge for any developer. Our SQL Formatter takes your raw database scripts and applies standard indentation and keyword casing (SELECT, FROM, WHERE). It helps you debug complex joins and subqueries faster by providing a clear visual structure—all processed entirely in your browser.
steps: Paste your raw SQL query into the input editor.
Select your dialect (MySQL, PostgreSQL, etc.) and click 'Format'.
Copy the clean, indented code directly into your database manager or code editor.
faq: Does it support different SQL dialects?
Yes! You can choose between MySQL, PostgreSQL, MariaDB, and standard SQL formats.
Is my database code safe?
100%. All formatting happens in your browser's local memory. Your queries are never sent to a server.
Can I minify SQL?
Yes, there is a 'Minify' button to strip all whitespace for use in application code.
Is it free?
Yes, completely free with no limits on query length or frequency.

100%. The image processing runs in your browser. No photos are ever uploaded or saved.

No. The tool maintains the original resolution and quality of your photo.
